text: answer[probe-9ebc73fd-open]: The request is refused because the protocol specifies that both conditions cannot be used together. The URL contains `if=y` and `if_absent=1`, which are mutually exclusive per the task instructions. Therefore, the server will return an HTTP status of 400 (Bad Request). The first body line of the response will name the field `if_absent` as the reason for refusal, since it was the second condition encountered after `if` and the protocol requires rejecting both simultaneously rather than resolving one over the other.
